RC-Freeze-What-Baseline-001 adjudicated the same claim UNRESOLVABLE under its qualification-tree-scoped scan (317 files); this seat's workspace-wide scan sharpens that finding - the address DOES resolve, to a fixture - while the disposition is unchanged. A freeze ratified over this "upstream" would inherit the fabricated authority permanently.
